package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"

	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for same_service_method_accepts_tx_and_begins_tx: Service methods that sometimes reuse a transaction and sometimes open one themselves.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type Order struct {
	ID     int
	Status string
}

type OrderService struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (s *OrderService) CompleteOrder(tx *gorm.DB, orderID int) error {
	if tx == nil {
		tx = s.db.Begin()
		defer tx.Rollback()
	}
	if err := tx.Model(&Order{}).Where("id = ?", orderID).Update("status", "completed").Error; err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("update failed: %w", err)
	}
	return tx.Commit().Error
}
